newsitem.title: USA: PDS Financial gets Iowa game license.
newsitem.headline: PDS Financial gets Iowa game license.

text.p: PDS Financial Corp said Wednesday it has been licensed by the Iowa Racing and Gaming Commission to own and possess gambling devices and associated equipment for use in the state.
PDS said the license allows the company to offer its specialized leasing program for slot machines and electronic gaming devices to casinos in Iowa.
PDS is also licensed as a gaming equipment distributor in Minnesota and has gaming license applications pending in other areas.
